text:
Amelia (CSM): Quick sync — can we get an SLO snapshot and evidence bundle for Acadia Health pilot by EOD Monday? They're asking for uptime/99 latency numbers before the renewal review. Renewal flagged if onboarding isn't green.

Ravi (SRE): I can pull the 30/7/1 windows. Current there: 99.87% uptime last 30d, p99 latency (gen path) = 420ms, p99 (embeddings) = 230ms. Will attach raw graphs. Do we need league-of-regions breakdown? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Leah (Solutions Eng): Please include recent rollout notes — we did a canary switch to the dedicated pool for their namespace last week. That changed tails on p95->p99. I have the rollout tag: `release/dedicated-acadia-03` and the canary logs. Also will add the KV cache warmup evidence.

Tom (AE): Flag: customer success team raised concerns in the call yesterday — if we miss the SLO targets for onboarding window (SLO: 99.9 uptime, p99 <= 350ms for gen) they want credit conversation and a revision to go-live timeline. We should precompute the credit exposure (month pro-rata).

Amelia (CSM): Good — can someone run the credit calc and a short blurb we can send to the customer (no legalese)? Need two variants: optimistic (we meet SLOs after warmup) and conservative (we miss and owe credits).

Ravi (SRE): I'll run query and produce a simple CSV with windows and violation minutes. Quick SQL I ran locally:```select window_start, window_end, sum(violation_minutes) as vmin from slo_violations where customer='acadia' and window_start >= '2026-02-01' group by 1,2;``` Will convert to credit calc (credits = vmin/43200 * monthly_commit).

Leah (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the one-paragraph explanation for customers on why p99 spiked (cache eviction during canary + bursty prefix traffic). Suggest this wording: "We observed transient p99 increases during the canary cutover; Root cause was KV cache cold-start and placement hot-sharding. Mitigation: pre-warm cache and throttle rollout. Expected impact: <24h to stabilize." Use that if helpful.

Tom (AE): Can we also include a short enablement invite for their ops folks? Asking for a 30-min session to walk them through traffic shaping best practices and how credits are tracked. I'll schedule once we have the packet. :spiral_calendar_pad:

Amelia (CSM): Perfect. Who owns the evidence bundle upload to the customer portal (we need logs, graphs, timeline, credit calc, and mitigation plan)? Also include a single-sheet SLO snapshot (one pager).

Ravi (SRE): I'll own upload. Plan: compile graphs (uptime, p50/p95/p99), attach canary timeline, and `slo_violations.csv`. ETA: Monday 18:00 UTC.

Leah (Solutions Eng): I'll produce the one-pager and the short explanation + runbook snippet (how to request a temporary burst window). ETA: Monday 16:00 UTC.

Tom (AE): I'll draft the customer-facing email and the calendar invite. Can you add the exact credit numbers when ready and I'll finalize wording.

ops-bot: Incident snapshot generated for customer=acadia, id=inc-20260303-ACD. Artifacts: https://redwood.internal/archives/inc-20260303-ACD (read-only).

Amelia (CSM): Thanks all — last ask: in the one-pager include a simple remediation timeline (T+0 immediate, T+1h mitigations in place, T+24h stabilization). We want to show proactive ops posture.

Ravi (SRE): Will do. Also, quick question for Leah — do we want to propose a temporary routing policy to fallback to a lower-cost model variant if p99 persists? Could reduce credits risk.

Leah (Solutions Eng): Yes — propose fallback policy named `acadia-fallback-v1` that routes to quantized variant under latency degradation for <= 2h. Add that to the playbook.

Amelia (CSM): Great. I'll collect everything and send draft to Tom for customer wording. If anyone hits blockers DM me. :thumbsup:
